# Gallerix

> > Gallerix is a comprehensive online art museum and marketplace featuring 500K+ paintings from 40K+ artists, museums worldwide, and contemporary creators.

Gallerix combines a vast digital museum of historical and contemporary art with ArtClub, a marketplace for buying and selling original artworks. The platform spans classical masters, Russian painters, digital art, handmade crafts, and literary analysis tied to visual culture.

## Key Topics

- Online Museum
- Art Gallery
- Famous Artists
- Painting Collections
- Old Masters

## Museum & Collections

- [Painting and paintings – Gallerix online museum](https://gallerix.org): Gallerix online museum: 40K+ artists, 500K+ paintings from museums worldwide
- [Art Gallery – the most famous artists](https://gallerix.org/a1): Directory of famous artists: Van Gogh, Monet, Da Vinci, Aivazovsky, Shishkin
- [Museums online](https://gallerix.org/album/Museums): Directory of major museums: Louvre, Uffizi, Vatican, Borghese Gallery
- [Russian and soviet painters. All Paintings, free](https://gallerix.org/album/Russians): Collection of Russian/Soviet painters: Repin, Levitan, Serov, Surikov
- [Художники (Архив)](https://gallerix.org/storeroom): Alphabetical artist directory and archive catalog of painters

## ArtClub Galleries

- [Artist Sites. Buy and sell paintings | Gallerix ArtClub](https://in.gallerix.org): Gallerix ArtClub: marketplace for buying and selling paintings
- [Contemporary art | Gallerix ArtClub](https://c.gallerix.org): ArtClub gallery for contemporary and abstract art
- [Digital art, computer graphics | Gallerix ArtClub](https://digital.gallerix.org): ArtClub gallery for digital art, computer graphics, and AI-generated art
- [Pencil and pen drawings, graphics, watercolors | Gallerix ArtClub](https://graf.gallerix.org): ArtClub gallery for pencil drawings, watercolors, and graphics
- [Handmade, needlework | Gallerix ArtClub](https://crafts.gallerix.org): ArtClub gallery for handmade crafts, needlework, and decorative objects

## Learning & Art Education

- [Learning](https://gallerix.org/learn): Art tutorials: drawing techniques, oil painting, figure and landscape drawing

## Literary & Cultural Content

- [Books](https://gallerix.org/lit): Literary summaries and analysis of classic novels and historical fiction
- [A summary of Count Cagliostro by Alexei Tolstoy](https://gallerix.org/news/lit/202603/graf-kaliostro-aleksey-tolstoy): Literary summary of Alexei Tolstoy's Count Cagliostro (1919-1921)
- [The Innkeeper's Tales review by Walter Scott, summary](https://gallerix.org/news/lit/202603/rasskazy-traktirshika-valter-skott): Walter Scott's 1817 critical review of The Innkeeper's Tales series
- [Films about artists](https://gallerix.org/read/filmy-o-xudozhnikax): Curated collection of feature films about artists and art cinema
